author: charles-h-spurgeon
fields.title: Bakubirize Bajje
fields.summary: Spurgeon talina bugumiikiriza bwa kwanjula — ekiragiro kya kuwaliriza, era agenderera okukigondera mu bubaka bwennyini. Bulina ebitundu bibiri: okusooka okunoonya n’okuzuula abamuwuliriza, ng’ayogera ku mutamiivu, ku eyeesigama ku mpisa ze ennungi, ne ku oyo aweddemu essuubi, omu ku omu; n’oluvannyuma okubawaliriza mu buli ngeri okuggyako amaanyi ag’omubiri. Akomekkereza ng’akwasa ebinaavaamu Mukama we.
main_points: Spurgeon agenderera okugondera ekiragiro eky’okuwaliriza mu bubaka bwennyini.
Okusooka anoonya n’azuula abamuwuliriza: omutamiivu, eyeesigama ku mpisa ze ennungi, aweddemu essuubi, n’abalala, omu ku omu.
N’oluvannyuma abawaliriza okuyingira mu buli ngeri okuggyako amaanyi ag’omubiri.

study_questions.question: “Okubirize b’onoosangayo bajje” kitegeeza ki mu Lukka 14:23?
study_questions.answer: Mu lugero lw’embaga ennene, kye kiragiro kya mukama eri omuddu we okukubiriza abali ebweru — abali mu nguudo ne mu bukubo — okukkiriza okuyitibwa. Spurgeon akitwala ng’omulimu ogw’okwegayirira n’obunyiikivu abo ababuze.

study_questions.question: Spurgeon ayogera n’ani mu bubaka buno?
study_questions.answer: Anoonya n’azuula buli ngeri ya muwuliriza, omu ku omu — omutamiivu, eyeesigama ku mpisa ze ennungi, n’oyo eyeeraliikirira oba aweddemu essuubi — nga tannaba kunyweza kuyitibwa kw’enjiri eri buli omu.

study_questions.question: Spurgeon agezaako atya “okuwaliriza” abamuwuliriza?
study_questions.answer: Mu buli ngeri ey’okumatiza okuggyako amaanyi ag’omubiri — okuwa ensonga, okulabula, n’okwegayirira — era akomekkereza ng’akwasa Kristo ebinaavaamu, kubanga Katonda yekka y’ayinza okufuula okuwaliriza okwo okw’amaanyi.

study_questions.question: Obubaka obukulu obwa “Bakubirize Bajje” bwe buluwa?
study_questions.answer: Nti okuyitibwa kw’enjiri kwa mangu era kuteekwa okunywezebwa ku boonoonyi awatali kulwa — okuyita Spurgeon kw’agondera mu bubaka bwennyini ng’ayegayirira abamuwuliriza butereevu okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero.

fields.body_html:
“…okubirize b’onoosangayo bajje.”—Lukka 14:23.

NNINA ekyangu kingi nnyo okugenda okugondera ekiragiro kino enkya ya leero, nga mbirize okuyingira abo abakyalwira mu nguudo ne mu bukubo, ne kiba nti siyinza kulinda kwanjula, wabula nteekwa okutandikirawo omulimu gwange.

Kale muwulire, mmwe abatamanyi mazima nga bwe gali mu Yesu—muwulire obubaka bwe mbaleetedde. Mwagwa, mwagwa mu jjajjammwe Adamu; era nammwe mwennyini mwagwa, olw’ebibi byammwe ebya buli lunaku n’obutali butuukirivu bwammwe obutakoma; musunguwazizza Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo; era nga bwe kiri ekituufu nti mwayonoona, bwe kityo Katonda ateekwa okubabonereza bwe munaagenda mu maaso n’obutali butuukirivu bwammwe, kubanga Mukama Katonda wa bwenkanya, era tasonyiwa n’akatono oyo azzizza omusango. Naye temuwulirangako, tekyabategeezebwa dda mu matu gammwe, nti Katonda, mu kusaasira kwe okutaliiko kkomo, yakola ekkubo, awatali kwonoona kitiibwa kye, mw’asobola okubasaasira, mmwe abazzizza omusango era abatasaanira? Mmwe gye njogera; eddoboozi lyange lyolekedde mmwe, abaana b’abantu; Yesu Kristo, Katonda ddala ava mu Katonda ddala, yakka okuva mu ggulu, n’afuulibwa mu kifaananyi ky’omubiri ogw’ekibi. Ng’azaaliddwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, yazaalibwa Maliyamu Embeerera; yawangaala mu nsi eno obulamu obw’obutukuvu obw’okulabirako, n’obw’okubonaabona okusingayo, okutuusa ku nkomerero lwe yeewaayo okufa olw’ebibi byaffe, “Omuntu Omutuukirivu ku lw’abatali batuukirivu, alyoke abaleete eri Katonda.” Era kaakano enteekateeka y’obulokozi ebategeezebwa mu bwangu—“Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu onoolokolebwa.” Mmwe abamenye ebiragiro bya Katonda byonna, ne munyooma okusaasira kwe, ne mweyita ku kuwoolera eggwanga kwe, okusaasira kukyabalangirirwa, kubanga “Buli alikoowoola erinnya lya Mukama alirokoka.” “Ekigambo kino kituufu, kisaanye okukkiriza, ekigamba nti Kristo Yesu yajja mu nsi okulokola aboonoonyi. Mu bo nze mwonoonyi asookera ddala;” “buli ajja gy’ali talimugobera bweru, era ayinza okulokolera ddala abajja eri Katonda ku bubwe, kubanga abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza.” Kaakano byonna Katonda by’abasaba—era ekyo ye y’akibawa—kwe kutunuulira obutunuulizi Omwana we avaamu omusaayi era afa, n’okwesiga emmeeme zammwe mu mikono gy’oyo, erinnya lye lyokka lye liyinza okulokola okuva mu kufa ne ggeyeena. Si kintu kya kwewuunya, nti okulangirira enjiri eno tekukkirizibwa bantu bonna nga bali bumu? Omuntu yandirowoozezza nti amangu ddala nga kino kibuuliddwa, nti “buli amukkiriza alyoke afune obulamu obutaggwaawo,” buli omu ku mmwe, “ng’asuula ebibi bye n’obutali butuukirivu bwe,” yandikutte Yesu Kristo, n’atunuulira omusaalaba gwe gwokka. Naye woowe! obubi bw’obutonde bwaffe bwe butyo obw’entiisa, n’okwonooneka kw’empisa zaffe bwe kutyo okuzikiriza, nti obubaka buno bunyoomebwa, okuyitibwa ku mbaga ey’enjiri kugaanibwa, era bangi ku mmwe leero balabe ba Katonda olw’ebikolwa ebibi, balabe ba Katonda oyo abaabuulira Kristo leero, balabe b’oyo eyatuma Omwana we okuwaayo obulamu bwe ng’omutango okununula abangi. Kyewuunyisa, nzizza, nti kibe bwe kityo, naye era ge mazima, era kyova kyetaagisa ekiragiro ky’ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe,—“okubirize b’onoosangayo bajje.”

Abaana ba Katonda, mmwe abakkiriza, sijja kuba na kinene oba kye nnaayogera nammwe enkya ya leero; ŋŋenda butereevu ku mulimu gwange—ŋŋenda okunoonya abo abagaana okujja—abo abali mu makubo ne mu bukubo, era Katonda bw’anaagenda nange, kaakano omulimu gwange kwe kutuukiriza ekiragiro kino, “okubirize b’onoosangayo bajje.”

Ekisooka, nteekwa okubanoonya ne mbazuula; eky’okubiri, nja kukola omulimu ogw’okubawaliriza okuyingira.

I. Ekisooka, nteekwa OKUBANOONYA NE MBAZUULA. Bwe musoma ennyiriri ezisooka ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe, mujja kusanga ekiragiro kino nga kinnyonnyoddwa mu bujjuvu: mukama n’alagira omuddu we “agende mangu mu nguudo ez’omu kibuga ne mu bikubo, ayite abaavu n’abagongobavu, n’abalema, ne bamuzibe;” n’oluvannyuma, “Genda mu nguudo ez’omu byalo,” oyingize abatambuze, n’abanyazi b’oku makubo, “ne mu bukubo obutono,” oyingize abo abatalina we bagalamiza mitwe gyabwe, abeebaka wansi w’ebisaka okuwummula, nabo baleete, era “okubirize b’onoosangayo bajje.” Weewaawo, mbalaba enkya ya leero, mmwe abaavu. Nteekwa okuwaliriza mmwe okuyingira. Muli baavu mu by’ensi, naye kino tekiziyiza kuyingira mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, kubanga Katonda teyaggya ku kisa kye omuntu akankana mu bikunta, era atalina mugaati. Mazima ddala, bwe wabaawo enjawulo yonna ekolebwa, enjawulo eri ku ludda lwammwe, era olw’obulungi bwammwe—“obubaka buno obw’obulokozi, bwaffe ffenna wamu”; “n’abaavu babuulirwa Enjiri.” Naye okusingira ddala nteekwa okwogera nammwe abaavu mu mwoyo. Temulina kukkiriza, temulina mpisa nnungi, temulina kikolwa kirungi, temulina kisa, era obwavu obusinga byonna obubi, temulina kusuubira. Ah, Mukama wange mmwe abaweerezza okuyitibwa okw’ekisa. Mujje, mwaniriziddwa ku mbaga ey’obugole ey’okwagala kwe. “Buli ayagala ajje anywe ku mazzi ag’obulamu ag’obuwa.” Jjangu, nteekwa okukukwata, newakubadde ng’oyonoonese n’obucaafu obusingayo, era newakubadde nga tolina kirala ku mugongo gwo wabula ebikunta, newakubadde ng’obutuukirivu bwo bufuuse ng’ebiwero ebicaafu, naye nteekwa okukukwata, n’okusooka okukuyita, era n’okukuwaliriza okuyingira.

Kaakano nkulaba nate. Toli mwavu kyokka, naye oli mugongobavu. Waaliwo ekiseera lwe walowooza nti oyinza okwekolera obulokozi bwo awatali buyambi bwa Katonda, lwe walowooza nti oyinza okukola ebikolwa ebirungi, okugoberera emikolo, n’otuuka mu ggulu ku bubwo; naye kaakano oli mugongobavu, ekitala ky’amateeka kikutemyeko emikono, era kaakano tokyasobola kukola; oyogera, n’ennaku ennyingi—

“Ebikolwa by’emikono gyange ebisingayo obulungi,

Tebiguma kulabika mu maaso g’entebe yo.”

Kaakano ofiiriddwa amaanyi gonna ag’okugondera amateeka; owulira nti bw’oyagala okukola ebirungi, ekibi kiba naawe. Oli mugongobavu; olese, ng’ekintu ekitaliiko ssuubi, okugezaako kwonna okwerokola, kubanga oli mugongobavu era emikono gyo gigenze. Naye oli mu mbeera embi n’okusingawo, kubanga newakubadde nga tewandisobodde kwekolera kkubo lyo okutuuka mu ggulu, wandisobodde okutambula okutuukayo ku luguudo olw’okukkiriza; naye oli mugongobavu mu bigere nga bw’oli mu mikono; owulira nti tosobola kukkiriza, nti tosobola kwenenya, nti tosobola kugondera bisaanyizo by’enjiri. Owulira nti ozikiridde ddala, tolina maanyi mu ngeri yonna okukola ekintu kyonna ekiyinza okusanyusa Katonda. Mazima ddala, okaaba ng’ogamba nti—

“Ayi, singa nnali nsobola okukkiriza,

Olwo byonna byandibadde byangu,

Njagala, naye sisobola, Mukama, nnyamba,

Obuyambi bwange buteekwa kuva gy’oli.”

Era naawe ntumiddwa gy’oli. Mu maaso go nteekwa okuwanika ebbendera y’omusaalaba ebunye omusaayi, gy’oli nteekwa okubuulira enjiri eno, “Buli alikoowoola erinnya lya Mukama alirokoka;” era gy’oli nteekwa okukaaba nti, “Buli ayagala ajje anywe ku mazzi ag’obulamu ag’obuwa.”

Waliwo n’ekibinja ekirala. Muli balema. Mutta aganaaga wakati w’endowooza bbiri. Oluusi mwagala okufaayo ennyo ku by’eddiini, ate ekiseera ekirala amasanyu g’ensi ne gabayita. Okweyongerayo okutono kwe mukola mu by’eddiini kuba kuwenyera buwenyezi. Mulina amaanyi matono, naye matono nnyo ne kiba nti mweyongerayo mu bulumi. Ah, owoluganda awenyera, era naawe obubaka buno obw’obulokozi bukutumiddwa. Newakubadde ng’otta aganaaga wakati w’endowooza bbiri, Mukama antuma gy’oli n’obubaka buno: “Mulituusa wa okutta aganaaga? Obanga Mukama ye Katonda mumugoberere, naye obanga Baali ye Katonda mugoberere oyo.” Mweddeko ku neeyisa yammwe; teekateeka ennyumba yo, kubanga togenda kulama, ogenda kufa. Kyendiva nkukola bwe ntyo, ggwe Isirayiri… weetegeke okusisinkana Katonda wo, ggwe Isirayiri! Lekera awo okuwenyera, wabula salawo okubeera ku ludda lwa Katonda n’amazima ge.

Era ate ndaba ekibinja ekirala,—bamuzibe. Weewaawo, mmwe abatasobola kwerabako, abeerowooza okuba abalungi so nga mujjudde obubi, abayita ekikaawa ekiwoomu n’ekiwoomu ekikaawa, ekizikiza ekitangaala n’ekitangaala ekizikiza; mmwe gye ntumiddwa. Mmwe, emmeeme enzibe z’amaaso ezitasobola kulaba mbeera yammwe ey’okubula, abatakkiriza nti ekibi kibi nnyo nga bwe kiri, era abatakkiriza kumatizibwa kulowooza nti Katonda wa bwenkanya era mutuukirivu, mmwe gye ntumiddwa. Era nammwe abatasobola kulaba Mulokozi, abatalaba bulungi mu ye mwe muyinza okumwegomba; abatalaba bulungi mu mpisa ennungi, wadde ekitiibwa mu ddiini, wadde essanyu mu kuweereza Katonda, wadde okunyumirwa mu kuba abaana be; nammwe, mmwe gye ntumiddwa. Weewaawo, ani gwe situmiddwa bwe ntwala ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe? Kubanga kigenda n’ewala okusinga kino—tekikoma ku kuwa kunnyonnyola okw’enjawulo kyokka, buli muntu alyoke asangibwe mu mbeera ye, wabula oluvannyuma kyeyanjuluza ku bonna, ne kigamba nti, “Genda mu nguudo ez’omu byalo ne mu bukubo obutono.” Wano tuyingiza abantu ab’emitendera gyonna n’embeera zonna—omwami ku mbalaasi ye mu luguudo, n’omukazi atambula ng’agenda ku mirimu gye, n’omubbi ateega omutambuze—bano bonna bali mu luguudo, era bonna balina okuwalirizibwa okuyingira, era eyo mu bukubo mwe mugalamidde emmeeme enaku ze bafunda ez’obulimba zikunguddwa, ezinoonya okufuna akabeerero akatono olw’emitwe gyazo egikooye, nammwe, gye tutumiddwa enkya ya leero. Kino kye kiragiro ekya bonna—bakubirize bajje.

Kaakano, nsiriikiridde nga mmaze okunnyonnyola embeera zino, nsiriikiridde okutunuulira omulimu omuzito ennyo oguli mu maaso gange. Melanchthon yayogera bulungi nti, “Adamu omukadde yali wa maanyi nnyo eri Melanchthon omuto.” Nga bwe kyandibadde kyangu omwana omuto okugezaako okuwaliriza Samusooni, bwe kityo bwe kiri gye ndi okugezaako okukulembera omwonoonyi okutuuka ku musaalaba gwa Kristo. Era naye Mukama wange antuma ku mulimu ogwo. Laba, ndaba olusozi olunene mu maaso gange olw’okwonooneka kw’abantu n’obutafaayo obukakanyavu, naye mu kukkiriza nkaaba nti, “Ggwe olusozi olunene weyita ki? Mu maaso ga Zerubbaberi olibeera lusenyi.” Mukama wange agamba nti, bakubirize bajje? Kale, newakubadde ng’omwonoonyi ali nga Samusooni ate nze ndi mwana, ndimukulembera n’akagoye. Katonda bw’agamba nti kikole, bwe nkigezaako mu kukkiriza kirikolebwa; era bwe nnaanoonya leero, n’omutima ogusinda, ogulwana, era ogukaaba, okuwaliriza aboonoonyi okujja eri Kristo, okuwaliriza okuwoomu okw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu kujja kugenda na buli kigambo, era abamu ddala bajja kuwalirizibwa okuyingira.

II. Kaakano ku mulimu —butereevu ku mulimu. Abasajja n’abakazi abatannakyuka, abatannatabaganyizibwa ne Katonda, abatannazaalibwa buggya, nteekwa OKUBAWALIRIZA OKUYINGIRA. Mmpa olukusa okusooka okubasisinkana mu nguudo z’ekibi mbabuulire nate omulimu gwange. Kabaka w’eggulu abaweereza enkya ya leero okuyitibwa okw’ekisa. Agamba nti, “Nga bwe ndi omulamu, bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda, sisanyukira kufa kw’abakozi ba bibi, wabula bo okukyuka ne bava mu kkubo lyabwe ebbi ne baba balamu:” “Mujje nno tukubaganye ebirowoozo, bw’ayogera Mukama; ebibi byammwe ne bwe biba ng’olugoye olumyufu binaafuuka byeru ng’omuzira, ne bwe binaaba bitwakaavu nga langi emyufu enkwafu, binaatukula ng’ebyoya by’endiga.” Owoluganda omwagalwa, kisanyusa omutima gwange okulowooza nti nnina amawulire amalungi bwe gatyo ge nnyinza okukubuulira, naye era njatula nti emmeeme yange ezitowa kubanga ndaba nga tolowooza nti mawulire malungi, wabula ogakuba amabega, n’otogafaako nga bwe kisaanidde. Mmpa olukusa okukubuulira Kabaka ky’akukoledde. Yali amanyi omusango gwo, yalaba nga bukyali nti ojja kwezikiriza. Yali amanyi nti obwenkanya bwe bwandisabye omusaayi gwo, era olw’okuwona obuzibu buno, obwenkanya bwe bulyoke bufune ekyabwo kyonna, era ggwe olyoke olokolebwe, Yesu Kristo yafa. Kale tunuulira akaseera katono ekifaananyi kino. Olaba omusajja oli afukamidde mu nnimiro ya Gesusemane, ng’atuuyana amatondo g’omusaayi. Olaba n’ekino ekiddako: olaba oyo abonaabona ennyo ng’asibiddwa ku mpagi ng’akubibwa embooko ez’entiisa, okutuusa amagumba g’ebibegabega lwe galabika ng’ebizinga ebyeru wakati mu nnyanja y’omusaayi. Ate olaba ekifaananyi kino eky’okusatu; y’omusajja y’omu awanikiddwa ku musaalaba ng’emikono gye gigoloddwa, n’ebigere bye nga bikomereddwa n’emisumaali, ng’afa, ng’asinda, ng’avaamu omusaayi; ne ndowooza nti ekifaananyi kyayogera ne kigamba nti, “Kiwedde.” Kaakano bino byonna Yesu Kristo ow’e Nazaaleesi yabikola, Katonda alyoke asonyiwe ekibi nga tasudde bwenkanya bwe; era obubaka eri ggwe enkya ya leero bwe buno—“Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu onoolokolebwa.” Kwe kugamba, mwesige, ova ku bikolwa byo, n’amakubo go, oteeke omutima gwo ku musajja ono yekka, eyeewaayo ku lw’aboonoonyi.

Kale owoluganda, nkubuulidde obubaka, kiki ky’obwogerako? Obukuba amabega? Ongamba nti si kintu gy’oli; tosobola kubuwuliriza; nti ojja kumpuliriza luvannyuma; naye ojja kugenda mu kkubo lyo leero ofeeyo ku nnimiro yo n’obusuubuzi bwo. Yimirira owoluganda, saagambibwa kukubuulira bubuulizi ate ne ngenda ku mirimu gyange. Nedda; ŋŋambiddwa okukuwaliriza okuyingira; era mmpa olukusa okukulaga nga sinnaba kweyongerayo, nti waliwo ekintu kimu kye nnyinza okwogera—era Katonda ye mujulirwa wange ku kino enkya ya leero, nti ndi wa mazima gy’oli mu kwagala kwange oteeke mu nkola ekiragiro kino ekya Katonda. Oyinza okunyooma obulokozi bwo, naye nze sibunyooma; oyinza okugenda n’ewerabira by’onoowulira, naye kikusanyuse okujjukira nti ebintu bye njogera kaakano bimmalidde okusinda kungi nga sinnajja wano okubyogera. Emmeeme yange ey’omunda ddala eyogera naawe, owoluganda wange omwavu, bwe nkwegayirira ku lw’oyo omulamu eyali afudde, era kaakano omulamu emirembe gyonna, lowooza ku bubaka bwa Mukama wange bw’ang’amba kaakano okukutuusaako.

Naye obunyooma? Okyabugaana? Kale nteekwa okukyusa eddoboozi lyange okumala akaseera. Sijja kukoma ku kukubuulira bubaka, n’okukuyita nga bwe nkola n’obunyiikivu bwonna, n’okwagala okw’amazima—nja kweyongerayo. Omwonoonyi, mu linnya lya Katonda nkulagira okwenenya n’okukkiriza. Ombuuza obuyinza bwange buva wa? Ndi mubaka wa ggulu. Ebiwandiiko ebinkakasa, ebimu bya kyama, biri mu mutima gwange; n’ebirala biri mu lwatu mu maaso go leero mu bubonero bw’obuweereza bwange, nga batudde era nga bayimiridde mu kizimbe kino, Katonda mw’ampeeredde emmeeme nnyingi ng’empeera yange. Nga Katonda ataliiko nkomerero bw’ampadde obuvunaanyizibwa okubuulira enjiri ye, nkulagira okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo; si ku buyinza bwange, wabula ku buyinza bw’oyo eyagamba nti, “Mugende mu nsi yonna mubuulire Enjiri eri abantu bonna;” n’oluvannyuma n’agattako okulabula kuno okw’amaanyi, “Abo bonna abakkiriza ne babatizibwa balirokolebwa, naye abo abatakkiriza balisalirwa omusango ne gubasinga.” Gaana obubaka bwange, era ojjukire nti “Omuntu yenna eyajeemeranga amateeka ga Musa yattibwanga awatali kusaasirwa, bwe waabangawo abajulirwa babiri oba basatu abamulumiriza. Noolwekyo omuntu alinnyirira Omwana wa Katonda… talibonerezebwa n’obukambwe obusingawo?” Omubaka tateekwa kuyimirira wansi w’omuntu gw’akolagana naye, kubanga ffe tuyimiridde waggulu. Omuweereza bw’alonda okutwala ekifo kye ekituufu, ng’asibiddwa mu kiwato n’obuyinza bwa Katonda obutaliiko kkomo, era ng’afukiddwako amafuta ge amatukuvu, ateekwa okulagira abantu, n’okwogera n’obuyinza bwonna ng’abawaliriza okuyingira: “ng’onenya, ng’ozaamu amaanyi, wakati mu kugumiikiriza.”

Naye okyuka n’ogamba nti tojja kulagirwa? Kale nate nja kukyusa eddoboozi lyange. Ekyo bwe kitagasa, engeri endala zonna zijja kugezesebwa. Owoluganda wange, nzija gy’oli n’ebigambo ebyangu, era nkukubiriza oddukire eri Kristo. Ayi owoluganda wange, omanyi Kristo bw’ali ow’okwagala? Ka nkubuulire okuva mu mmeeme yange kye mmumanyiiko. Nange nnali mmunyooma. Yakonkona ku luggi lw’omutima gwange ne ngaana okuluggulawo. Yajja gye ndi emirundi egitabalika, buli nkya ne buli kiro; yannenya mu muntu wange ow’omunda n’ayogera nange n’Omwoyo we, era bwe yamaliriza, okubwatuka kw’amateeka bwe kwawangula mu muntu wange ow’omunda, ne ndowooza nti Kristo yali mukambwe era atalina kisa. Ayi, siyinza kwesonyiwa olw’okumulowoozaako obubi bwe butyo. Naye nga nnaanirizibwa n’okwagala kungi nnyo bwe nnagenda gy’ali! Nnalowooza nti anankuba, naye omukono gwe tegwali muzingirire mu busungu wabula gwali mugolole nnyo mu kusaasira. Nnalowooza nga ndi mukakafu nti amaaso ge gandimpasizzaako okumyansa kw’obusungu; naye, mu kifo ky’ekyo, gaali gajjudde amaziga. Yangwa mu kifuba n’annywegera; n’anzigyako ebikunta byange n’annyambaza obutuukirivu bwe, n’aleetera emmeeme yange okuyimba waggulu olw’essanyu; ate mu nnyumba y’omutima gwange ne mu nnyumba y’ekkanisa ye ne mubaamu ennyimba n’amazina, kubanga omwana we gwe yali abuze yali azuuliddwa, era oyo eyali afudde yali azuukiziddwa. Kale nkukubiriza, tunuulira Yesu Kristo omulisibwe. Omwonoonyi, tolyejjusa,—nja kweyimirira ku lwa Mukama wange nti tolyejjusa,—tolisinda nga weegomba okuddayo mu mbeera yo ey’okusalirwa omusango; olifuluma Misiri n’oyingira mu nsi ensuubize n’ogisanga ng’ekulukuta amata n’omubisi gw’enjuki. Ebigezo by’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo olibisanga nga bizito, naye olisanga ng’ekisa kibifuula ebyangu. Ate ku ssanyu n’okunyumirwa kw’okubeera omwana wa Katonda, bwe mba nga nnimba leero, olinvunaana mu nnaku ezijja. Bw’onookola nga bwe kyawandiikibwa nti, “Mulegeeko mulabe nga Mukama bw’ali omulungi!” sitya nti tolisanga nti si mulungi kyokka, naye nti asinga n’obulungi emimwa gy’abantu bwe giyinza okumwogerako.

Simanyi nsonga ki ze nnaakozesa naawe. Nkwegayirira olw’obulungi bwo ggwe kennyini. Ayi mukwano gwange omwavu, tekyandibadde kirungi gy’oli okutabaganyizibwa ne Katonda w’eggulu, okusinga okuba omulabe we? Kiki ky’ofuna mu kuwakanya Katonda? Osanyuka nnyo olw’okuba omulabe we? Ddamu, ggwe anoonya amasanyu; wasanga okunyumirwa mu kikopo ekyo? Nziramu, ggwe eyeerowooza okuba omutuukirivu: wasanga ekiwummulo eky’ekigere kyo mu bikolwa byo byonna? Ayi ggwe atambulatambula ng’onoonya okunyweza obutuukirivu bwo, nkukuutira oleke omuntu wo ow’omunda ayogere. Wasanga nga lye kkubo ery’essanyu? Ah, mukwano gwange, “Lwaki musaasaanya ensimbi zammwe ku ebyo ebitali bya kulya muteganira ebyo ebitakkusa? Mumpulirize, mumpulirize n’obwegendereza mulye ebyo ebirungi, emmeeme yammwe eneesanyuka nnyo.” Mbakubiriza olwa buli kintu ekitukuvu era eky’ekitiibwa, buli kintu ekikulu era eky’olubeerera, “Mudduke muwonye obulamu bwammwe, temutunula mabega wadde okuyimirira mu kiwonvu,” temuyimirira okutuusa nga mukakasizza, era nga mufunye omugabo mu musaayi gwa Yesu Kristo, omusaayi ogwo ogutunaazaako buli kibi kyonna. Okyali munyogovu era atafaayo? Muzibe tanzikiriza kumukulembera okumutwala ku mbaga? Owoluganda wange omugongobavu tateeke mukono gwe ku kibegabega kyange anzikirize okumuyamba okutuuka ku kijjulo? Omwavu tanzikiriza kutambula naye ku lusegere? Nteekwa okukozesa ebigambo eby’amaanyi okusingawo. Nteekwa okukozesa okuwaliriza okulala okubawaliriza okuyingira? Aboonoonyi, ekintu kino kimu kye maliridde enkya ya leero, bwe mutalokolebwa temulibaako kye mwewolereza. Mmwe, okuva ku b’envi okutuuka ku baana abato ennyo, bwe mutakwata Kristo leero, omusaayi gwammwe gulibeera ku mitwe gyammwe. Bwe wabaawo amaanyi mu muntu okuleeta munne, (nga bwe gabaawo omuntu bw’ayambibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu) amaanyi ago gajja kukozesebwa enkya ya leero, Katonda ng’annyamba. Jjangu, sijja kuggwamu maanyi olw’okunneegaana kwo; okukubiriza kwange bwe kunaalemererwa, nteekwa okujja ku kintu ekirala. Owoluganda wange, nkwegayirira, nkwegayirira oyimirire olowooze. Omanyi ky’ogaana enkya ya leero? Ogaana Kristo, Omulokozi wo yekka. “Kubanga tewali n’omu ayinza kuteekawo musingi mulala;” “tewali linnya ddala na limu mu mannya gonna agaaweebwa abantu, wansi w’eggulu, mwetugwanira okulokolebwa.” Owoluganda wange, siyinza kugumiikiriza ggwe okukola kino, kubanga nzijukira ky’ewerabira: olunaku lujja lw’oliba weetaaga Omulokozi. Tekiri wala emyezi egikooya giggwe, n’amaanyi go gatandike okukendeera; entunnunsi yo ejja kukuggwaako, amaanyi go gajja kugenda, era ggwe n’ekisolo ekyo eky’entiisa—okufa, mujja kutunuulagana. Olikola otya Yoludaani bw’eryanjaala nga tolina Mulokozi? Ebitanda by’okufiirako biba bikakanyavu ng’amayinja awatali Mukama Yesu Kristo. Okufa kintu kya ntiisa mu ngeri yonna; n’oyo alina essuubi erisingayo obulungi, n’okukkiriza okusingayo okuwangula, asanga nti okufa si kintu kya kusekerera. Kintu kya ntiisa okuva mu birabika okugenda mu bitalabika, okuva mu bifa okugenda mu bitafa, okuva mu biseera okugenda mu lubeerera, era olisanga nga kizibu okuyita mu miryango egy’ekyuma egy’okufa awatali biwaawaatiro ebiwoomu ebya bamalayika okukukulembera okutuuka ku miryango gy’eggulu. Kiriba kizibu okufa awatali Kristo. Siyinza butakulowoozaako. Nkulaba ng’olinga eyeetta enkya ya leero, era neerowooza nga nnyimiridde ku mabbali g’ekitanda kyo nga mpulira okukaaba kwo, era nga mmanyi nti ofa nga tolina ssuubi. Ekyo siyinza kukigumiikiriza. Ndowooza nga nnyimiridde kaakano ku mabbali g’essanduuko yo, nga ntunuulira amaaso go agannyogovu ng’ettaka, era nga ŋŋamba nti. “Omuntu ono yanyooma Kristo era n’atafaayo ku bulokozi obukulu.” Ndowooza amaziga agakaawa ge ndikaaba olwo, bwe ndirowooza nti saakubeerera mwesigwa, era amaaso ago agazibiddwa ddala mu kufa nga galirabika ng’agannenya ne gagamba nti, “Omubuulizi, nnajjanga mu Music Hall, naye tewali wa mazima gye ndi; wansanyusa, wambuulira, naye tewanneegayirira. Tewamanya Pawulo kye yategeeza bwe yagamba nti, ‘Katonda atuma ffe okwogera nammwe. Kyetuva tubeegayirira, ku bwa Kristo, mutabagane ne Katonda.’”

Nkwegayirira obubaka buno buyingire mu mutima gwo olw’ensonga endala. Neerowooza nga nnyimiridde mu maaso g’entebe y’omusango eya Katonda. Nga Mukama bw’ali omulamu, olunaku olw’omusango lujja. Ekyo okikkiriza? Toli mukafiiri; omuntu wo ow’omunda teyandikukkirizza kubuusabuusa Byawandiikibwa. Oboolyawo oyinza okuba nga weefuula okukikola, naye tosobola. Owulira nti wateekwa okubaawo olunaku Katonda lw’alisalira ensi omusango mu butuukirivu. Nkulaba ng’oyimiridde wakati mu kibiina ekyo ekinene, era eriiso lya Katonda nga likutunuulidde. Kikulabikira nga tatunuulira walala wonna, wabula ggwe wekka, era akuyita okujja mu maaso ge; n’asoma ebibi byo, n’ayogerera waggulu nti, “Muveewo, mmwe abakolimire, mulage mu muliro ogutazikira!” Omuwuliriza wange, siyinza kugumiikiriza kukulowoozaako ng’oli mu mbeera eyo; kirabika nga buli luviiri ku mutwe gwange luteekwa okuyimirira bwe ndowooza ku muwuliriza wange yenna okusalirwa omusango ogw’okuzikirira. Mujja kwerowooza nga muli mu mbeera eyo? Ekigambo kifulumye nti, “Muveewo, mmwe abakolimire.” Olaba obunnya nga bwasamye okukumira? Owulira okuwowoggana n’okukuba ebiwoobe kw’abo abaakusooka okutuuka mu nnyanja eyo ey’olubeerera ey’okubonaabona? Mu kifo ky’okunnyonnyola ekifo ekyo, nkyukira gy’oli n’ebigambo bya nnabbi eyaluŋŋamizibwa, ne ŋŋamba nti, “Ani ku ffe ayinza okubeera awamu n’omuliro ogusaanyaawo? Ani ku ffe ayinza okubeera awamu n’omuliro ogutaliggwaawo?” Ayi! owoluganda wange, siyinza kukuleka kusuula ddiini bw’otyo; nedda, ndowooza ku ekyo ekijja oluvannyuma lw’okufa. Nnandibadde sirina buntu bwonna singa nnalaba omuntu ng’agenda okwenywesa obutwa, ne sikasuka kikopo; oba singa nnalaba omulala ng’agenda okubuuka okuva ku Lutindo lwa London, ne sikuyamba kumuziyiza obutakikola; era nnandibadde mubi okusinga dayimooni singa saakwegayiridde kaakano, n’okwagala kwonna, n’ekisa, n’obunyiikivu, nti, “nywezanga obulamu obutaggwaawo,” era nti, “Temukolerera mmere eggwaawo, wabula munoonye emmere ebeerera era etuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.”

Omu ku Bakalvini abasukkiridde yandiŋŋambye nti nsobya okukola bwe ntyo. Siyinza kukyewala. Nteekwa okukikola. Nga bwe nteekwa okuyimirira mu maaso g’Omulamuzi wange ku nkomerero, mpulira nti siriba nnatuukiriza bulungi buweereza bwange okuggyako nga mbegayiridde n’amaziga mangi mulokolebwe, mutunuulire Yesu Kristo era mufune obulokozi bwe obw’ekitiibwa. Naye kino tekigasa? okwegayirira kwaffe kwonna kubafiiriddeko bwereere; muziba amatu? Kale nate nkyusa eddoboozi lyange. Omwonoonyi, nkwegayiridde ng’omuntu bwe yeegayirira mukwano gwe, era singa kyali kya bulamu bwange nze siyandisobodde kwogera n’obunyiikivu okusinga bwe njogera enkya ya leero ku bubwo. Nnali mpulira obunyiikivu ku mmeeme yange, naye si kusinga ku bwe mpulira ku mmeeme z’ekibiina kyange enkya ya leero; n’olwekyo, bwe munaagaana okwegayirira kuno, nnina ekirala:—nteekwa okubatiisatiisa. Temujja kufunanga bulijjo kulabulwa nga kuno. Olunaku lujja, eddoboozi lya buli mubuulizi w’enjiri lwe lirisirika, waakiri gy’oli; kubanga okutu kwo kuliba kunnyogovu mu kufa. Tekiriba nate kutiisatiisa; kiriba kutuukirizibwa kw’okutiisatiisa okwo. Teriba nate kisuubizo, wadde okulangirira okusonyiyibwa n’okusaasira; teriba musaayi oguleeta emirembe, wabula oliba mu nsi Ssabbiiti mw’emirwa mu biro eby’okubonaabona ebitaggwaawo, era okubuulira enjiri mwe kuziyizibwa kubanga tekwandigasizza. Kale nkukuutira, wuliriza eddoboozi lino eryogera kaakano n’omuntu wo ow’omunda; kubanga bw’otaliwulirize, Katonda alyogera naawe mu busungu bwe, n’akugamba mu kunyiiga kwe okw’amaanyi nti, “na bayita ne mugaana okuwuliriza, ne ngolola omukono ne wataba n’omu afaayo… kale nange ndibasekerera nga muli mu nnaku, era mbakudaalire ng’entiisa ebagwiridde.” Omwonoonyi, nkutiisatiisa nate. Jjukira, kiseera kitono kyokka ky’oyinza okufuna okuwulira okulabula kuno. Olowooza nti obulamu bwo bujja kuba buwanvu, naye omanyi nga bwe buli obumpi? Wali ogezezzaako okulowooza nga bw’oli omunafu? Wali olabye omubiri nga gusaliddwasaliddwa omukugu mu kukebera emibiri? Wali olabye ekintu ekyewuunyisa ng’omubiri gw’omuntu?

“Kyewuunyisa, ennanga ey’enkoba lukumi,

Okusigala ng’ekuba bulungi okumala ebbanga eddene bwe lityo.”

Ka omu ku nkoba ezo azingibwe buzingibwa, ka akamwa akamu ak’emmere kakwate ekkubo ekikyamu buli, era oyinza okufa. Akabenje akasingayo obutono, nga bwe tukayita, kayinza okukusindika amangu mu kufa, Katonda bw’aba ayagadde. Abasajja ab’amaanyi battiddwa obubenje obusingayo obutono era obutali bwa maanyi, era naawe bwe kiyinza okuba. Mu kkanisa, mu nnyumba ya Katonda, abantu bagudde ne bafiirawo. Emirundi emeka gye tuwulira ku bantu abagwa mu nguudo zaffe—ne bava mu biseera ne bagwa mu lubeerera, olw’okukubwa okw’amangu? Era okakasa nti omutima gwo ogwo mulamu bulungi ddala? Omusaayi gutambula bulungi ddala? Okakasa ddala ekyo? Era bwe kiba bwe kityo, kiribeera bwe kityo okumala bbanga ki? Ayi, oboolyawo wano waliwo abamu ku mmwe abatalituuka ku lunaku lwa Ssekukkulu; kiyinza okuba nti ekiragiro kifulumye dda, “Teekateeka ennyumba yo, kubanga togenda kulama, ogenda kufa.” Mu kibiina kino ekinene ennyo, nnyinza okubala obulungi bameka abaliba bafudde mu mwaka gumu; naye kya mazima nti ffenna awamu tetulisisinkana nate mu lukuŋŋaana lwonna. Abamu ku kibiina kino ekinene, oboolyawo babiri oba basatu, baligenda ng’omwaka omuggya tegunnayingira. Kale nkujjukiza, owoluganda wange, nti oba omulyango gw’obulokozi guyinza okuggalwawo, oba ggwe oyinza okuba ng’oli wala n’ekifo omulyango gw’okusaasira we guli. Kale jjangu, okutiisatiisa ka kube n’amaanyi gy’oli. Sitiisatiisa kubanga njagala kukutiisa awatali nsonga, wabula mu ssuubi nti okutiisatiisa kw’owoluganda kuyinza okukugoba okutuuka mu kifo Katonda w’ategekedde embaga y’enjiri. Era kaakano, nteekwa okukyuka ne ŋŋenda nga sirina ssuubi? Mmazeeyo byonna bye nnyinza okwogera? Nedda, nja kujja gy’oli nate. Mbuulira kiki, owoluganda wange, ekikuziyiza okujja eri Kristo. Mpulira omu ng’agamba nti, “Ayi, ssebo, kubanga mpulira nga nzizza omusango munene nnyo.” Ekyo tekiyinza kuba, mukwano gwange, ekyo tekiyinza kuba. “Naye, ssebo, nze mwonoonyi asookera ddala.” Mukwano gwange, si ggwe. Omwonoonyi asookera ddala yafa n’agenda mu ggulu emyaka mingi emabega; erinnya lye yali Sawulo ow’e Taluso, oluvannyuma eyayitibwa Pawulo omutume. Ye yali omwonoonyi asookera ddala, mmanyi nti yayogera mazima. “Nedda,” naye okyagamba nti, “ndi mubi nnyo.” Toyinza kuba mubi okusinga omwonoonyi asookera ddala. Ateekwa, waakiri, okuba ow’okubiri mu bubi. Ne bwe tugamba nti ggwe asinga obubi mu balamu kaakano, oli wa kubiri mu bubi, kubanga ye ye yali asookera ddala. Naye ka tugambe nti ggwe asinga obubi, eyo si ye nsonga yennyini lwaki osaanidde okujja eri Kristo? Omuntu gy’akoma okuba omubi, gy’akoma okuba n’ensonga okugenda mu ddwaliro oba eri omusawo. Gy’okoma okuba omwavu, gy’okoma okuba n’ensonga okukkiriza ekirabo ky’omulala. Kaakano, Kristo teyeetaaga birungi byo byonna by’okoze. Awa bwereere. Gy’okoma okuba omubi, gy’okoma okwanirizibwa. Naye ka nkubuuze ekibuuzo: Olowooza oliba bulungi okusingawo ng’osigala wala ne Kristo? Bw’oba olowooza bw’otyo, omanyi kitono nnyo ku kkubo ly’obulokozi. Nedda, ssebo, gy’onookoma okulwawo, gy’onookoma okwonooneka; essuubi lyo lijja kunafuwa, okuggwaamu essuubi kwo kujja kweyongera amaanyi; omusumaali Setaani gw’akusibisizza gujja kweyongera okunywera, era ojja kusigala n’essuubi ttono okusinga bwe kyali. Jjangu, nkwegayirira, jjukira nti tewali ky’ofuna mu kulwawo, naye mu kulwawo buli kintu kiyinza okufiirwa. “Naye,” omulala akaaba nti, “mpulira nga sisobola kukkiriza.” Nedda, mukwano gwange, era tolikkiriza n’akatono bw’onoosooka okutunuulira okukkiriza kwo. Jjukira, sizze kukuyita eri okukkiriza, wabula nzize kukuyita eri Kristo. Naye ogamba nti, “Njawulo ki eriwo?” Lwaki, eno yokka: bw’osooka okugamba nti, “Njagala okukkiriza ekintu,” tokikola n’akatono. Naye ekibuuzo kyo ekisooka kiteekwa kuba nti, “Kintu ki kino kye nteekwa okukkiriza?” Olwo okukkiriza kujja kujja ng’ekivudde mu kunoonya okwo. Omulimu gwaffe ogusooka tegukwata ku kukkiriza, wabula ku Kristo. Jjangu, nkwegayirira, ku lusozi Kalvaliyo, olabe omusaalaba. Laba Omwana wa Katonda, oyo eyatonda eggulu n’ensi, ng’afa olw’ebibi byo. Mutunuulire, tewali maanyi mu ye ag’okulokola? Tunuulira amaaso ge agajjudde okusaasira. Tewali kwagala mu mutima gwe okulaga nti ayagala okulokola? Mazima, omwonoonyi, okulaba Kristo kujja kukuyamba okukkiriza. Tosooka kukkiriza n’oluvannyuma n’ogenda eri Kristo, oba si ekyo okukkiriza kwo kujja kuba kintu kitaliimu mugaso; genda eri Kristo nga tolina kukkiriza kwonna, weesuule ku ye, oba onoobbira oba onoowuga. Naye mpulira omulala ng’akaaba nti, “Ayi ssebo, tomanyi mirundi emeka gye nnayitibwa, ebbanga ddene ki lye mmaze nga ngaana Mukama.” Simanyi, era saagala kumanya; kye mmanyi kyokka kwe kuba nti Mukama wange antumye, okukuwaliriza okuyingira; kale jjangu naffe kaakano. Oyinza okuba ng’ogaanye okuyitibwa lukumi; tofuula kuno okw’olukumi mu kumu. Obadde ogenda mu nnyumba ya Katonda, era okakanyaziddwa bukakanyazibwa n’enjiri. Naye siraba izziga mu liiso lyo? Jjangu, owoluganda wange, tokakanyazibwa bubaka bwa nkya ya leero. Ayi, Omwoyo wa Katonda omulamu, jjangu osaanuure omutima guno kubanga tegusaanuukangako, era omuwalirize okuyingira! Siyinza kukuleka kugenda olw’ensonga ezitaliimu ng’ezo; bw’oba ng’omaze emyaka emingi bwe gityo ng’onyooma Kristo, ezo nsonga nnyingi bwe zityo lwaki kaakano tosaanidde kumunyooma. Naye nkuwulidde ng’oyogera mpola nti kino si kiseera kirungi? Kale nnaakugamba ki? Ekiseera ekyo ekirungi kirituuka ddi? Kirituuka ng’oli mu ggeyeena? Ekiseera ekyo kiriba kirungi? Kirituuka ng’oli ku kitanda kyo eky’okufiirako, ng’okufaafaagana kw’okufa kuli mu mumiro gwo—olwo kye kirituuka? Oba ng’entuuyo eyokya ekwokya ku kyenyi, era ate ng’entuuyo ennyogovu ey’ekinyirikivu eri awo, ebyo biriba biseera birungi? Ng’obulumi bukusikasika, era ng’oli ku mabbali g’entaana? Nedda, ssebo, enkya ya leero kye kiseera ekirungi. Katonda akifuule bwe kityo. Jjukira, sirina buyinza kukusaba kujja eri Kristo enkya. Mukama takuwadde kuyitibwa kujja gy’ali ku Lwokubiri oluddako. Okuyitibwa kuli nti, “Leero bwe munaawulira eddoboozi lye temukakanyaza mitima gyammwe nga bwe mwakola bwe mwajeema,” kubanga Omwoyo agamba nti “leero.” “Mujje nno tukubaganye ebirowoozo;” lwaki okyongezaayo? Kiyinza okuba okulabula okw’enkomerero kw’olifuna. Kyongezeeyo, era oyinza obutaddamu kukaaba mu kkanisa. Oyinza obutaddamu kwogerwako bubaka obw’obunyiikivu bwe butyo. Oyinza obutaddamu kwegayirirwa nga bwe nandikwegayiridde kaakano. Oyinza okugenda, Katonda n’agamba nti, “Yeegasse n’abasinza ebifaananyi, mumuleke abeere yekka.” Alikuta ku nkoba ozeeyagalire; era olwo, weetegereze—olugendo lwo lukakafu, naye kwe kusalirwa omusango okukakafu n’okuzikirira okw’amangu.

Era kaakano nate, byonna bya bwereere? Tojja kujja kaakano eri Kristo? Kale nnaakola ki ekirala? Nnina ekintu kimu kyokka ekisigaddeyo, era nakyo kijja kugezesebwa. Nnyinza okukkirizibwa okubakaabira; nnyinza okukkirizibwa okubasabira. Muyinza okunyooma obubaka buno bwe mubanga mwagadde; muyinza okusekerera omubuulizi; muyinza okumuyita omulalu bwe munaayagala; tajja kubanenya, tajja kubawaabira eri Omulamuzi omukulu. Omusango gwammwe, ku ludda lwe, gusonyiyiddwa nga tegunnakolebwa; naye mujja kujjukira nti obubaka bwe mugaana enkya ya leero buva eri oyo abaagala, era bubaweebwa n’emimwa gy’oyo abaagala. Mujja kujjukira nti muyinza okuzannya emmeeme zammwe ne Setaani ne muzifiirwa, nti muyinza obutafaayo ne mukitwala ng’ekintu ekitali kikulu; naye waliwo waakiri omuntu omu omulamu afaayo ddala ku mmeeme yammwe, era omu eyalwana ne Katonda we nga tannajja wano olw’amaanyi ag’okubabuulira, era bw’aliba ng’avudde mu kifo kino talyerabira bamuwuliriza ba nkya ya leero. Nzizza nate nti, ebigambo bwe bitulemerera tusobola okuwaayo amaziga—kubanga ebigambo n’amaziga bye byokulwanyisa abaweereza b’enjiri bye bakozesa okuwaliriza abantu okuyingira. Temumanyi, era ndowooza temwandisobodde kukkiriza, omuntu Katonda gw’ayise mu buweereza bw’aba yeeraliikirira nnyo ku kibiina kye, n’okusingira ddala ku bamu ku bo. Mbadde mpulidde ennaku zino ku mulenzi omuvubuka eyamala ebbanga ddene ng’ajja wano, era essuubi lya kitaawe lyali nti alituusibwa eri Kristo. Naye yamanyiganako n’omukafiiri; era kaakano alagajjalira emirimu gye, era abeera mu kibi buli lunaku. Nnalaba amaaso ga kitaawe ag’ennaku agaasiiwuuse; saamusaba kumbuulira ebyafaayo ye kennyini, kubanga nnawulira nga kwandibadde kusiikuula buzibu na kusumulula kiwundu; ntya, oluusi, nti envi z’omusajja oyo omulungi ziyinza okukka n’ennaku emagombe. Abavubuka, temwesabira mwekka, naye bannyammwe babalwanirira mu kusaba. Temufaayo ku mmeeme zammwe, naye bakitammwe beeraliikirira ku lwammwe. Mbadde mu nkuŋŋaana ez’okusaba, ne mpulira abaana ba Katonda nga basaba omwo, era tebandisobodde kusaba n’obunyiikivu n’obulumi obw’amaanyi okusingawo singa buli omu ku bo yali anoonya obulokozi bw’emmeeme ye. Era si kya kwewuunya nti ffe twetegefu okunyeenya eggulu n’ensi olw’obulokozi bwammwe, ate mmwe nga temulina kirowoozo ku mmwe mwennyini, nga temufaayo ku bintu ebitaggwaawo?

Kaakano nkyukira akaseera kamu eri abamu abali wano. Waliwo abamu ku mmwe wano ab’ekkanisa ez’Ekikristaayo, abeeyatula okuba abakkiriza, naye okuggyako nga nkusobezza—era nja kusanyuka bwe kiba bwe kityo—okwatula kwammwe bulimba. Temukutuukiriza, mukuswaza; musobola okubeera nga bulijjo temujja mu nnyumba ya Katonda, oba n’okukola ebibi ebisinga ekyo obubi. Kaakano mbabuuza mmwe abatanyiriza njigiriza ya Katonda Omulokozi wammwe, mulowooza nti muyinza okumpita omusumba wammwe, ate nga emmeeme yange teyinza kukankana ku lwammwe n’okubakaabira mu kyama? Nate, nzizza nti kiyinza okuba nga si kikulu nnyo gye muli engeri gye mwonoonamu ebyambalo by’Obukristaayo bwammwe, naye kikulu nnyo eri abakwekebwa ba Katonda, abasinda era abakaaba, era abanakuwala olw’obutali butuukirivu bw’abeeyatula mu Sayuuni.

Kaakano waliwo ekirala ekisigalidde omuweereza okuggyako okukaaba n’okusaba? Weewaawo, waliwo ekintu kimu ekirala. Katonda yawa abaweereza be, si buyinza bwa kuzaala buggya, naye yabawa ekintu ekiringa ekyo. Tekisoboka muntu yenna kuzaala buggya muliraanwa we; naye abantu bazaalibwa batya eri Katonda? Omutume tagamba ku muntu ng’oyo nti yamuzaala ng’ali mu njegere ze? Kaakano omuweereza aweereddwa Katonda obuyinza, okutwalibwa nga kitaawe era nnyina w’abo abazaalibwa eri Katonda, kubanga omutume yagamba nti yalumwa ng’omukazi azaala ku lw’emmeeme okutuusa Kristo lwe yatondebwa mu bo. Kale tuyinza kukola ki? Kaakano tuyinza okwegayirira Omwoyo. Mmanyi nti mbuulidde enjiri, nti ngibuulidde n’obunyiikivu; nsoomooza Mukama wange okussa ekitiibwa mu kisuubizo kye. Yagamba nti ekigambo kye tekiriddayo bwereere, era tekiriddayo. Kiri mu mikono gye, so si mu gyange. Siyinza kubawaliriza, naye ggwe Ayi Omwoyo wa Katonda alina ekisumuluzo ky’omutima, ggwe oyinza okuwaliriza. Wali weetegerezza mu ssuula eyo ey’Okubikkulirwa, we kigamba nti, “Laba nnyimiridde ku luggi era nkonkona,” ennyiriri ntono emabega, omuntu y’omu ayogerwako, ng’oyo alina ekisumuluzo kya Dawudi. Bwe kityo okukonkona bwe kutagasa, alina ekisumuluzo era asobola era ajja kuyingira. Kaakano okukonkona kw’omuweereza omunyiikivu bwe kutabawangula enkya ya leero, wakyasigaddeyo okuggulwawo okwo okw’ekyama okw’omutima okukolebwa Omwoyo, mulyoke muwalirizibwe.

Nnalowooza nti mulimu gwange okutegana nammwe ng’alinga nze nzekka ateekwa okukikola; kaakano nkiteeka mu mikono gya Mukama wange. Tekiyinza kuba kwagala kwe ffe okulumwa ng’abazaala, ate ne tutazaala baana ba mwoyo. Kiri mu ye; ye mukama w’omutima, era olunaku luliraga, nti abamu ku mmwe, nga bawaliriziddwa ekisa eky’obufuzi, bafuuse abasibe abeeyagalidde aba Yesu awangula byonna, era bamufukaamiridde emitima gyabwe olw’obubaka bw’enkya ya leero.
